svg.title: CO2-Response: the Uno R4 build on a full breadboard
svg.text: CO2-Response · the whole Uno R4 build on a full-size breadboard, hole by hole

Columns 1-63, rows a-e above the centre channel and f-j below it. The five holes of one column on one side of the channel (e.g. a12-e12) are joined inside the board; the channel separates them from f12-j12.
Each rail is one long strip. W = wire, numbered as in docs/wiring.md; every wire end is a dot on its hole or pin. Dashed = optional. Wires that only cross are not joined.
The two + rails carry different supplies: never join them.
Q1 IRLZ44N: G f12 · D f13 · S f14
female ends of the jumpers on its header
on the valve; magnet on its handle
its own 2 leads → g27, g29 (either way)
top view · USB-C on the left
D13 LED = alarm light (nothing to wire)
Micro-B: computer side · USB-A: device side
≤100 mA: the Uno and the SFM3300 only
nothing on the breadboard goes to it
Never join the two + rails: they are different supplies.
Both − rails are GND and must be joined (W27).
If the red/blue lines on your board break in the middle, each
rail is two halves: bridge each break with a short jumper.
in: W22 from J1's end pin · out: W15 SprintIR-R VDD, W19 pump +
in: W23 from J1's middle pin · out: W29 button (opt.) · joined to the bottom − rail by W27
in: W2 Arduino GND · out: W9 shifter, W17 Q1 source, R2, W21 reed, W28 buzzer (opt.)
in: W1 Arduino 5V · out: W7 SFM3300 VDD, W8 shifter HV
Every wire, end to end (hole names as printed on the breadboard)
Arduino GND (power header) → bottom − rail, col 47
bottom − rail, col 45 → j43 (shifter GND, 5 V side)
a43 (shifter GND, 3 V side) → SprintIR-R pin 3 GND
top + rail, col 45 → SprintIR-R pin 4 VDD
Arduino D10 → j8 (R1 to the gate)
J1 end pin (c3 column): a3 → top + rail, col 4
J1 middle pin (c5 column): a5 → top − rail, col 6
top − rail, col 3 → bottom − rail, col 3
a35 (button, diagonal leg) → top − rail, col 36

Parts in holes: J1 c3/c5/c7 · Q1 IRLZ44N f12 G, f13 D, f14 S (printed side towards row j) · R1 220 Ω h8-h12 · R2 100 kΩ i12 → bottom − rail · U1 shifter A1-A4 side d40-d45, B side g40-g45 · reed leads g27, g29 · buzzer g20 (+), g23 (opt.) · button e33/e35/f33/f35 (opt.)

Check the shifter's printed pin names against this order (A1 A2 LV GND A3 A4 / B1 B2 HV GND B3 B4) and keep each wire on the column of the named pin. Optional R3, R4 4.7 kΩ I2C pull-ups and the Q2 heater driver (W26) are not drawn; see docs/wiring.md.
